assertions.name: every gate the requirement names is reported exactly once
every gate says what it examined, however it turned out
the two derived lists agree with the gates they came from
the backup gate answers from the declared record and never from its absence
a missing backup record fails the gate rather than passing it
the gate never claims to have seen the archive itself
passing the technical gates is never stated as a legal conclusion
the storage gate reports what the database itself is configured to do
the identity gate is scoped to this organisation and not to every owner in the database
the identity gate counted the primary owners that actually exist locally
the runtime gate names the address this process is really serving on
the runtime gate names the interpreter this process is really running on
a loopback-only HTTP profile is not reported as a transport failure, and says why
the telemetry gate read the environment this process is actually running with
the package gate is decided by whether the installed version has a verified manifest behind it
a failing package gate names what to do about it rather than only reporting a red mark
the egress gate counted the configured endpoints and says the firewall is not what it checked
an auditor may read the gates
an actor without installation-health authority is refused
